# QR Tool Studio

> Free, privacy-first QR code generator that runs entirely in the browser.
> No account, no upload, no tracking — the QR code is rendered on your device.

## What it does

- 8 QR code types: URL, vCard, WiFi, text, email, phone, SMS, location
- 6 matrix styles and 5 eye styles, linear and radial gradients
- Center logo upload (PNG / JPG / SVG)
- Export PNG (1024px) / SVG / JPEG; batch generation packaged as ZIP
- Works offline after first load; nothing is sent to a server

- [QR Code Generator](https://toolbox168.xyz/): the tool itself

## Facts

- Runs fully client-side; images and text never leave the device
- No sign-up and no watermark
- Generated codes are static and never expire
- Output follows the ISO/IEC 18004 QR code specification
